title: Chapter 19
text: 108. EXT. DR MANN’S PLANET - DAY Cooper SCRAMBLES to his knees. Dr Mann approaches - DR MANN I’m sorry - I can’t let you leave. COOPER Why?! DR MANN We’re going to need your ship to continue the mission ... once the others realize what this place isn’t. Cooper’s mind races. He looks around. COOPER You faked all the data? DR MANN I had a lot of time. COOPER Is there even a surface? DR MANN I’m afraid not - Dr Mann KICKS Cooper over the edge, Cooper CLINGS on - DR MANN I tried to do my duty, Cooper, but the day I arrived I could see this place had nothing. I resisted the temptation for years ... but I knew there was a way to get rescued. COOPER You fucking coward. Cooper BLASTS Dr Mann off his feet with his jet - SCRAMBLES up onto the ice. Dr Mann TACKLES him, they go down, WRESTLING. WIDER shows us two TINY FIGURES in a VAST LANDSCAPE, deciding the future of humanity with a BRAWL ...
